atten4.ptxt: The HDD navigation system stores various memories and settings after the ignition is turned OFF. Therefore, always wait 1 minutes after turning the ignition OFF before disconnecting the battery negative terminal.

s-1.ptxt: Steering Angle Adjustment and Camera Optical Axis Adjustment

s3.ptxt: Set the steering wheel in the straight-ahead position and stop the vehicle.

atten4.ptxt: Before stopping the vehicle, always move the vehicle slightly forward and backward, and check that not only the steering wheel but also the tires are in the straight-ahead position.

s3.ptxt: Adjust the tire pressure to the specified value beforehand.
Place the camera optical axis adjustment target bars in the positions shown in the illustration.

atten4.ptxt: The camera optical axis adjustment target bars are tapes approximately 2.5 cm wide and 2 m long applied to the floor; check the color on the vehicle display and use a color that stands out.

atten3.ptxt: The adjustment must be performed with the engine running. Therefore, apply the parking brake, depress the brake pedal, move the shift lever to P, and take sufficient care that the vehicle does not move off.

s3.ptxt: Select "Function Inspection/Adjustment" on the service inspection screen to display the function inspection/adjustment screen.
Select "Camera Optical Axis Adjustment" on the function inspection/adjustment screen to display the steering angle adjustment screen.

item.ptxt: If "Checking Vehicle Speed" (displayed in red) is displayed in part A, check the DTCs of the HDD navigation system and take action according to the output code. (see )
If "Vehicle Speed Input OK" is displayed in part A, the vehicle speed signal is being input normally, so perform steering angle adjustment.
If the vehicle speed signal has not been input, part A displays "Checking Vehicle Speed" with a red background.
If "Checking Vehicle Speed" (displayed in red) is displayed in part A, the screen does not switch even if "Maximum Steering Angle Memory" or "Next" is selected.
If "Checking Vehicle Speed" (displayed in red) is displayed in part A, touch "Checking Vehicle Speed" (changes from red to orange) and then perform steering angle adjustment.

s3.ptxt: Check that the steering wheel is in the position for driving the vehicle straight ahead (approximately straight, ±5 degrees or less as a guide), and select "Steering Angle Neutral Point Memory".

After memorizing the steering angle neutral point, turn the steering wheel to the left until it stops, then to the right until it stops, and press "Maximum Steering Angle Memory". (Right may be done first)

At the moment it is pressed, a confirmation beep is output, the steering angle adjustment values (steering angle neutral point and maximum steering angle) are stored, and the screen switches to the camera optical axis adjustment screen.

item.ptxt: The adjustment values are not stored until the beep finishes sounding.
If all input signals are being input normally, the screen automatically switches to the camera optical axis adjustment screen after the maximum steering angle is memorized.
If steering angle adjustment has not been performed or "Checking Vehicle Speed" (displayed in red) is displayed in part A, selecting "Next" is not accepted.
Even if no DTC is detected, selecting "Maximum Steering Angle Memory" may not be accepted due to a steering sensor malfunction.
If selecting "Maximum Steering Angle Memory" is not accepted, replace the steering sensor. (see )
If the back door is open, "The back door is open. Close the back door before use." is displayed and camera optical axis adjustment cannot be performed.

If "Back door is open. Close the back door before use." is displayed even though the back door is closed, perform inspection according to Troubleshooting Flowchart ["Back door is open. Close the back door before use." is Displayed Even when Back Door is Closed]. (see )

s3.ptxt: Press switch A or B to rotate C so that it is parallel to the adjustment target bar.
Press switches D, E, F and G to move C left, right, up and down so that the adjustment target bar is in the center of C (center of the red frame).
Select "Next" to display the confirmation screen.

Check that A (indicating 117 cm from the bumper edge) and the adjustment target bar almost overlap. Also, check that when the steering wheel is in the straight-ahead position, the estimated course line is straight (overlaps the vehicle width extension line).
When "Complete" is selected, the screen changes to the function inspection/adjustment screen and the camera optical axis adjustment value is stored.

item.ptxt: When "Complete" is selected, a confirmation beep is output, the camera optical axis adjustment value is stored, and the display changes to the function inspection/adjustment screen.
The adjustment values are not stored until the beep finishes sounding.

atten4.ptxt: If the steering angle adjustment was performed, check the steering angle adjustment on the back guide monitor screen after canceling diagnosis.

s3.ptxt: On the back guide monitor screen, check that the estimated course line moves in conjunction with the steering wheel until the steering wheel is turned fully to the left or right.

atten4.ptxt: If the estimated course line stops moving before the steering wheel is turned fully to the left or right, the steering angle adjustment value has not been stored correctly, and adjustment must be performed again.

item.ptxt: If the only adjustment required after vehicle servicing is the camera optical axis adjustment, the steering angle adjustment is not necessary, so select "NEXT".
Do not touch the screen except for "Next".
If "Checking Vehicle Speed" (displayed in red) is displayed in part A, check the DTCs of the HDD navigation system and take action according to the output code. (see )
If "Vehicle Speed Input OK" is displayed in area A, the vehicle speed signal is being input normally, so select "NEXT".
If the vehicle speed signal has not been input, part A displays "Checking Vehicle Speed" with a red background.
If "Checking Vehicle Speed" (displayed in red) is displayed in area A, the screen does not change even if "NEXT" is selected.
If "Checking Vehicle Speed" (displayed in red) is displayed in part A, touch "Checking Vehicle Speed" (changes from red to orange) and then perform steering angle adjustment.
If the back door is open, "Back door is open. Close the back door before use." is displayed and camera optical axis adjustment cannot be performed.

If "Back door is open. Close the back door before use." is displayed even though the back door is closed, perform inspection according to Troubleshooting Flowchart ["Back door is open. Close the back door before use." is Displayed Even when Back Door is Closed]. (see )
